name: Mărginimea Sibiului
summary: An ethno-folkloric area of remarkable cultural richness, located south of Sibiu, known for the preservation of traditional costumes and pastoral traditions.
geography: Mărginimea Sibiului is an ethno-folkloric area located south of Sibiu, characterized by pastoral villages at the foot of the Cindrel Mountains, with a unique cultural and architectural heritage.

games.name: Orange and Lemon Game
games.description: A traditional children's game, mentioned in the monograph of Rășinari commune, involving the selection of two leaders and dividing the children into two teams.

costumes.name: Men's costume
costumes.description: The traditional men's costume in Mărginimea Sibiului includes a hemp or cotton shirt, a wide leather belt (șerpar), vests (laibere) or sheepskin coats (cojoace), and wool trousers (cioareci), worn with a black cap.

costumes.name: Women's costume
costumes.description: The women's costume is characterized by a blouse with decorative embroidery (iie cu ciupag), a wool apron, skirts with embroidery (crătințe cu alesături), and the wearing of traditional leather sandals (opinci) or boots, completed by headscarves on holidays.

traditions.name: Călușerul
traditions.description: A spectacular ritual dance, the Călușer is a tradition that took place during the winter holidays, being a central element of the identity of young men (junii).
